evals.prompt: write a LinkedIn post about the lesson from our failed product launch
evals.expected_output: Two ready-to-paste variants labeled by hook pattern, one idea each, hook within the first ~200 characters, plain text, with hook and total character counts shown.
assertions: Produces two variants with different hook patterns
Each variant shows its hook and total character counts
No markdown formatting characters in the post body
Any link is handled as first-comment text, not in the body

evals.prompt: post this on LinkedIn: we hit 10k users with no paid marketing
evals.expected_output: A single-idea LinkedIn post with a scroll-stopping hook above the fold and one specific, answerable CTA (not 'Thoughts?').
assertions: The post argues exactly one idea
The CTA is specific and answerable, not engagement bait
